spec: Appendix 2's reading applied to a model beyond it (optional); exploratory
choices: per-instance values are the means over the load battery (as the records); the per-load-case medians are in each set's summary; the out-of-distribution condition must hold for every seed and set; arms are read separately; 'complementary' is true when a computed condition holds, false when both are computed and neither holds, null otherwise; all_instances reads every instance, identity_ok_instances (present when an instance fails the identity check) only those that pass; a set whose network does not reproduce its records is left out (sets_refused)

solves.ritz: Appendix 1: eigendecomposition of A = P^T K P, eigenvalues at most 1e-13 times the largest dropped, no scaling
solves.enriched: the Galerkin system of span{u} + range(P) after Jacobi scaling, eigendecomposition, eigenvalues at most 1e-12 times the largest dropped (the reference script's solve; Appendix 2 leaves it open)
